match.appliesTo: All WSRF projects (minimum 25%, no more than half in-kind); statewide requests also need at least 10% of total project cost from roundtable Basin Account funds, and statewide WSRF funds cover at most 75% of project costs
match.quote: A minimum of 25% match is required for all WSRF projects. Greater weight may be given to projects with a higher match.

sections.name: Exhibit A (Statement of Work)
sections.quote: Upload a Word version of Exhibit A (Statement of Work)

criteria.name: Alignment with the respective Basin Implementation Plan(s)
criteria.quote: In general, the proposal will be evaluated on how well it aligns with the respective Basin Implementation Plan(s).

criteria.name: Multiple benefits, multiple purposes and multiple stakeholders
criteria.quote: Preference will be given to projects that have multiple benefits, multiple purposes and involve multiple stakeholders.

criteria.name: Project timing (earlier start date)
criteria.quote: Consideration is also given to the timing of projects with priority given to projects with an earlier start date.

criteria.name: Higher match
criteria.quote: Greater weight may be given to projects with a higher match.

other: Application documents are uploaded to the CWCB Portal
Exhibit A (Statement of Work) must be a Word document
The detailed budget (Exhibit B Budget & Schedule) must be in Excel
Letters of Commitment and photos or drawings are uploaded as PDFs
format.quote: Applicants must upload application documents into the online portal CWCB created to process water project grants and loans (CWCB Portal).

eligibility.item: Eligible applicants: governmental entities (municipalities, districts, enterprises, counties, State of Colorado agencies) and private entities (mutual ditch companies, non-profit corporations, partnerships, etc.)
eligibility.quote: Governmental Entities: Governmental entities include municipalities, districts, enterprises, counties, and State of Colorado agencies.

eligibility.item: Federal agencies are encouraged to work with local entities
eligibility.quote: Federal agencies are encouraged to work with local entities.

eligibility.item: Covered Entities (Section 37-60-126, C.R.S.) are eligible only if they have adopted an approved Water Efficiency Plan
eligibility.quote: Covered Entities as defined in Section 37- 60-126, C.R.S., are eligible if the applicant has adopted an approved Water Efficiency Plan.
A minimum of 25% match is required for all WSRF projects.

eligibility.item: No more than half of the match may be in-kind
eligibility.quote: Matching funds may consist of a combination of in-kind and cash match with no more than half of the match coming from in-kind.

eligibility.item: Identify matching funds as pending or secure and provide evidence (e.g. an award letter)
eligibility.quote: Applicants should identify matching funds as either pending or secure and provide evidence of those matching funds (such as an award letter).

eligibility.item: Matching funds must be secured within one year of the application date and before contracting
eligibility.quote: Matching funds must be secured within one year of the application date and prior to contracting.

eligibility.item: Statewide grant requests: at least 10% of the total WSRF project cost must come from roundtable Basin Account funds
eligibility.quote: at least one tenth (0.1 or 10%) of the total WSRF project cost⁸ must come from roundtable(s) Basin Account funds which can count toward the applicant's 25% match

eligibility.item: The application must be recommended by the basin roundtable, via a letter signed by the Roundtable Chair, before CWCB review
eligibility.quote: If the application is recommended for approval, the roundtable will submit a written recommendation to the CWCB signed by the Roundtable Chair through the CWCB Portal.

eligibility.item: WSRF funds generally cannot be used as match for a Water Plan Grant without written CWCB approval obtained before submission
eligibility.quote: WSRF grant funds are generally not eligible to be used as match funding for a Water Plan Grant and may not be approved.

requiredDocuments.item: Completed application through the CWCB Portal
requiredDocuments.quote: Completed Application through the CWCB Portal

requiredDocuments.item: Exhibit B Budget & Schedule, with a detailed budget in Excel
requiredDocuments.quote: Upload the Exhibit B Budget & Schedule. A detailed budget must be provided in Excel

requiredDocuments.item: Engineer's estimate of probable cost (construction projects over $100,000)
requiredDocuments.quote: Upload Engineer's estimate of probable cost for construction projects over $100,000
Upload Maps to the CWCB Portal (if applicable)

requiredDocuments.item: Letters of Commitment for matching funds, as PDFs
requiredDocuments.quote: Upload Letters of Commitment (matching funds) as PDFs
Upload Photos or drawings as PDFs

requiredDocuments.item: Roundtable letter of recommendation signed by the Roundtable Chair (submitted by the roundtable via the CWCB Portal), stating the Basin Account amount requested and how the activity meets Basin Implementation Plan goals
requiredDocuments.quote: The letter of recommendation must specify the amount of grant funding requested from the Basin Account and describe how the water activity meets Basin Implementation Plan goals.
